notes: The published title is sexually crude, so this page is titled Yannick Lapointe DS; the post's title is kept only in the source citation.

The strategy says 'This is the deck i have use at DPC Montréal'; the post gives no finish. The 2001 Montreal DPC page records Lapointe as the winner (from DeckTech tournament reports), so the finish is 1st.

Starting cards as posted under Starting (7): My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, 'maul's house', Prepared Defenses, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Crush The Rebellion and 'the new effect that grab retrieval cards'; these count toward the 60.
Posted 'maul's house' dested Tatooine: Desert Landing Site (the site where Maul's Sith Infiltrator lands; the Objective deploys the Galactic Senate and one other Episode I location).

Posted 'the new effect that grab retrieval cards' dested Do They Have A Code Clearance? (Coruscant: places opponent's just-used retrieval Interrupt or Utinni Effect on it); 'grabber' dested Allegations Of Corruption, the Dark Interrupt grabber from Coruscant.
The three unnamed Political Effects dested by their posted function: 'cancel drain' This Is Outrageous!, 'destiny +3' Our Blockade Is Perfectly Legal, 'drain +2' Motion Supported.
Posted 'elder something (the guy that limit battle destiny)' dested Edcel Bar Gane (in a senate majority, opponent draws no more than one battle destiny at battleground sites).

Posted 'those trick dont work on me (ghhhk effect)' dested Mind Tricks Don't Work On Me (cancels remaining battle damage, like Ghhhk); 'monnok & evader' dested the Reflections II combo Evader & Monnok; 'do or donut & empressive enforcement' There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement.

Posted 'maul tatooine' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); 'maul coruscant' Darth Maul, Young Apprentice; 'vader w stick' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'lott dott' Lott Dod; 'ticke' Tikkes; 'squabling debate' Squabbling Delegates; 'point concede' The Point Is Conceded; 'maul's strike' Maul Strikes; 'sebulba racer' Sebulba's Podracer; 'secret plans' the Special Edition Effect Secret Plans; 'enter the buraucraties' Enter The Bureaucrat.
Section headers with their counts ('dude15', 'green1', 'location2', 'purple1', 'red34') were mis-parsed by the machine draft as cards and are dropped.
The post is signed 'Yannick "2001 World Champion" Lapointe'.
